title: Backcasting Defense-in-Depth Math: How Independent Are Two Cheap Monitors Errors?

original_idea.body: On APPS backdoor tasks run two cheap monitors, record per-item correctness, compute error correlation and empirical joint catch rate vs the independence prediction.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests the independence assumption underpinning defense-in-depth safety cases, with an independently valuable deliverable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Run two monitors, record correctness, compute correlation; beginner-level stats on public data.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Foundational, training-free, lab-independent; weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Pure inference on APPS, analytical correlation.

novelty.reasoning: Monitor ensembling studied; this specific error-correlation measurement may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Ensemble/independence assumptions discussed; direct correlation measurement may be open.
